overview.description: The PGIM Active Aggregate Bond ETF (PAB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fixed income fund that holds USD-denominated securities issued by both government and corporate entities. These securities must be investment grade and have maturities of more than one year. PAB was launched on Apr 12, 2021 and is issued by PGIM.
